We study this representation choice as a form of optimizer geometry and introduce {\method}, a family of Muon-style optimizers that shares the same momentum rule and Newton--Schulz backend across native, nearest-square, skinny, and vector representations. Each Frobenius-isometric representation induces a distinct polar steepest-descent

summary.core_problem: Muon类优化器对动量做极分解更新前，需先将参数块reshape为矩阵，但现有工作默认使用参数的原生行列布局，未系统研究不同矩阵表示（即不同reshape方式）对Muon更新几何、收敛性质和实际训练效果的影响。
summary.importance: 将Muon优化器中原本隐式默认的矩阵表示选择，明确为可独立调节的设计轴，补全了Muon几何分析的关键环节。为大模型训练中Muon的超参调优、不同形状参数层（如注意力投影、MoE专家层）的适配提供了理论依据和实证参考，属于优化器方向的基础分析工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Muse框架，将同一参数块的四类Frobenius等距矩阵化操作——原生行列布局、最近正方形reshape、不同短边比例的瘦长reshape、退化为向量的端点（对应归一化带动量SGD）——统一到相同的动量更新规则和Newton-Schulz极分解后端下。理论上证明，每种矩阵表示对应一种独特的极最速下降几何：reshape后矩阵的短边长度直接决定极更新支持的奇异通道数量、更新方向的回拉缩放系数，以及随机非凸收敛界中的常数项。在师生模型实验中进一步观测到，曲率坍缩现象和Marchenko-Pastur（MP）谱分布与表示的短边长度直接相关，会导致训练早期归一化耗散的性能排序与短边长度负相关。
summary.experiments: 在LLaMA2-130M和LLaMA2-600M的预训练实验中验证了表示轴的实际效应：reshape后矩阵的短边越长（如最近正方形布局），验证损失越低；短边缩短时性能单调下降；退化为向量端点时性能最差，与理论推导的排序一致。师生模型实验中观测到的曲率窗口坍缩、MP谱形与短边长度的对应关系，也和理论预测吻合。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点关注第3节的几何分析核心结论（无需深究证明细节）、图1的表示轴总览，以及LLaMA2预训练的损失曲线对比，预计阅读时间20分钟。如果要在生产训练中落地Muon优化器，可以重点关注短边长度与收敛界常数的对应关系，用来适配不同形状的参数层。

summary_en.core_problem: Muon-style optimizers require reshaping parameter blocks into matrices before applying polar decomposition to momentum, but existing work defaults to each layer's native row-column layout without systematically investigating how alternative matrix representations (different reshaping schemes) alter Muon's update geometry, convergence properties, and real training performance.
summary_en.importance: This work elevates representation choice from an implicit default to an explicit, tunable design axis for Muon, filling a key gap in the geometric analysis of Muon optimizers. It provides theoretical grounding and empirical evidence for tuning Muon hyperparameters and adapting the optimizer to parameter layers of varying shapes (e.g., attention projections, MoE expert layers) during large model training, serving as a foundational analysis for optimizer development.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Muse framework unifies four classes of Frobenius-isometric matrixizations of the same parameter block — native layout, nearest-square reshape, skinny reshapes with varying short-side ratios, and the vector endpoint that reduces to normalized SGD with momentum — under a shared momentum rule and Newton-Schulz polar decomposition backend. Theoretically, each representation is shown to induce a distinct polar steepest descent geometry: the short-side length of the reshaped matrix directly determines the number of singular channels supported by the polar update, pullback scaling factors for the update direction, and constant terms in stochastic nonconvex convergence bounds. Teacher-student model experiments further reveal that curvature collapse and Marchenko-Pastur (MP) spectral profiles correlate directly with representation short-side length, driving an ordering of early normalized dissipation that scales inversely with short-side length.
summary_en.experiments: The representation axis is validated on LLaMA2-130M and LLaMA2-600M pretraining: longer short sides (e.g., nearest-square layout) yield lower validation loss, performance degrades monotonically as the short side shrinks, and the vector endpoint performs worst, matching the theoretically predicted ordering. Observations of curvature window collapse and MP spectral shape correlations with short-side length in teacher-student experiments also align with theoretical predictions.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the core geometric analysis conclusions in Section 3 (skip detailed proofs if not needed), the representation axis overview in Figure 1, and LLaMA2 pretraining loss comparisons; expected reading time is 20 minutes. Those deploying Muon in production training should pay special attention to the correspondence between short-side length and convergence bound constants to guide adaptation for layers of different shapes.

recommendation.zh: 如果内部在试 Muon，至少看 representation ablation；它改变的不是实现细节，而是有效优化几何。
recommendation.en: If you are testing Muon internally, read the representation ablations; this is optimizer geometry, not an implementation detail.

paper.title: Adaptive Runge-Kutta Step Control Buys Training Loss, Not Generalization: An Honest Compute-Matched Study of RK-Adam Optimizers
paper.abstract: Interpreting optimizers as gradient-flow discretizations has motivated applying higher-order Runge-Kutta (RK) integrators to neural networks. We build a representative Adam variant (Bogacki-Shampine 3(2) RK pair, FSAL reuse, local-error step control) and evaluate it under a strict compute-matched protocol giving every method the same gradient-evaluation budget - an accounting this literature rarely enforces. Under it the RK variant loses to plain Adam on training loss in both minibatch and full-

summary.core_problem: 现有基于Runge-Kutta积分器设计的Adam类优化器研究普遍未执行严格的计算量对齐，且自适应步长控制组件的实际有效性从未被实证检验，导致这类优化器的性能优势结论缺乏可信度。
summary.importance: 明确了优化器研究的对照实验规范：对比必须以梯度评估次数为算力对齐基准，而非优化器步数；同时验证了多数ODE启发式优化器的"自适应"组件在实际训练中可能完全失效，为后续高阶积分器类优化器的设计和实验提供了关键的 sanity check 参考。
summary.technical_approach: 实现了具有代表性的Bogacki-Shampine 3(2)阶RK结合Adam的优化器变体，执行严格的算力对齐协议：3阶RK每步对应3-4次梯度计算，FSAL阶段复用仅在全batch（确定性向量场）场景下计入算力节省，避免minibatch噪声下的无效记账。对容差ρ、最大步长h_max、初始步长h0做全参数扫描验证自适应控制器的实际行为，定位控制器失效的三个复合原因后完成修复，再通过消融实验分离自适应步长本身与梯度平均的独立效果。
summary.experiments: 1. 原始RK3(2)-Adam在minibatch和全batch场景下，同等梯度评估预算时训练损失均高于普通Adam；2. 原始设计的自适应控制器完全失效：98%-100%的步长卡在步长增长上限，容差参数跨两个数量级的调整产生比特级完全一致的训练轨迹；3. 修复控制器后，全batch场景下RK3(2)-Adam的训练损失比Adam低约40倍，但该优势来自自适应步长自然形成的warmup+增长调度，对初始步长高度敏感，且无法迁移到测试集精度提升；4. 全batch训练lr=0.003时，RK3(2)-Adam测试精度比同学习率Adam高0.51-0.8个点，10个随机种子全部胜出，但该收益来自梯度平均的隐式正则化效果，将Adam学习率调到0.01或使用NAdam/RMSprop即可在1/3单步算力成本下达到同等精度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第5节控制器失效的诊断分析和第7节泛化性消融实验，无需深究RK积分的具体公式。核心收获是优化器对比的算力对齐原则，以及自适应组件必须做实际行为的埋点验证，不能仅依赖理论设计假设。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Prior work on Runge-Kutta augmented Adam optimizers rarely enforces strict compute matching (counting gradient evaluations rather than optimizer steps), and the actual functionality of embedded adaptive step size controllers has never been empirically verified, leading to unsubstantiated claims of performance improvements.
summary_en.importance: Establishes a clear evaluation protocol for optimizer research: comparisons must be matched on gradient evaluation budget, not step count. It also demonstrates that many "adaptive" components in ODE-inspired optimizers are functionally inert in practice, providing a critical sanity check for future work on higher-order integrator-based optimizers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Implements a representative Bogacki-Shampine 3(2) RK variant of Adam, with FSAL stage reuse only credited in full-batch (deterministic vector field) settings to avoid invalid accounting under minibatch noise. Runs an exhaustive sweep over tolerance ρ, maximum step size h_max, and initial step size h0 to measure controller behavior, diagnoses three compounding root causes of controller failure, repairs the controller, and runs ablations to isolate the effect of adaptivity from gradient averaging.
summary_en.experiments: 1. The as-implemented RK3(2)-Adam underperforms vanilla Adam on training loss at equal gradient evaluation budgets in both minibatch and full-batch regimes. 2. The original adaptive controller is completely inert: step size saturates at its growth cap for 98-100% of steps, and tolerance values spanning two orders of magnitude produce bit-identical training trajectories. 3. After repairing the controller, RK3(2)-Adam achieves ~40x lower training loss than Adam in full-batch settings, but this gain comes from an implicit warmup-and-growth schedule induced by adaptive stepping, is highly sensitive to initial step size, and does not transfer to test accuracy. 4. At lr=0.003 in full-batch training, RK3(2)-Adam delivers 0.51-0.8 pt higher test accuracy than lr-matched Adam across 10 seeds, but this implicit regularization benefit from averaged gradients is matched or beaten by Adam at lr=0.01, NAdam, or RMSprop at 1/3 the per-step compute cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focused on Section 5 (controller failure diagnosis) and Section 7 (generalization ablations). No need to dive into RK integration details; the key takeaways are the compute-matching evaluation principle and the requirement to instrument adaptive components rather than relying on theoretical design claims. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 compute accounting 和 step-control 诊断；它提醒优化器论文先按梯度调用数结账，再谈收益。
recommendation.en: Read the compute accounting and step-control diagnostics; it is a useful reminder to price optimizer gains by gradient evaluations first.

paper.title: Reassessing Muon for Matrix Factorization
paper.abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large-scale deep learning, where it reshapes gradient updates through approximate orthogonalization and has been reported to outperform Adam and AdamW in large language model training. Its empirical success has motivated a growing body of theoretical work that interprets Muon as steepest descent under the spectral norm. Yet it remains unclear which of Muon's advantages stem from its update rule itself and which are artifacts of the scale, archi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“Muon 在大模型上有没有用”，而是更基础的问题：把架构、数据、规模这些混杂因素拿掉之后，Muon 这个优化器本身到底在什么问题上占优。作者选了低秩矩阵分解、矩阵补全和非负矩阵分解这类结构清楚、谱性质明确的问题，专门检验 Muon 的正交化更新是否真的能利用谱结构、改善病态条件下的优化，还是它在 LLM 里的收益更多来自深网特有的训练动力学。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义在于，它给 Muon 这类“矩阵感知”优化器降了一次噪。过去不少结论来自 GPT 类训练，容易把优化器效果和模型深度、归一化、数据分布、batch 规模混在一起。这里的结果比较克制：在标准低秩分解和矩阵补全上，只要调参公平，AdamW 和 GD 往往能追平甚至超过 Muon；Muon 的稳定优势主要出现在 NMF 这类存在冗余因子竞争、表示多样性更关键的约束问题上。对做 LLM 预训练的人，这意味着 Muon 不是一个“普适更优”的替代品，它更像是在某些几何结构下有偏好的更新规则。这个判断比单纯看大模型 loss 曲线更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者没有提出新优化器，而是做了一个控制变量很严的再评估。核心做法有三层。第一，选取可系统扫描的问题族：对称 PSD 低秩分解、一般矩阵补全，以及非负矩阵分解。它们分别覆盖了无约束低秩恢复、观测缺失、以及带非负约束和因子冗余的情形。第二，做等预算、细调参比较。论文强调 Muon、Adam、AdamW、GD 都经过系统调参，而不是沿用社区默认超参，这一点很关键，因为 Muon 的 reported gain 很容易受学习率、动量、weight decay、正交化近似步数影响。第三，围绕“谱结构是否真的被利用”来解释结果。Muon 的更新会对梯度矩阵做近似正交化，相当于压平奇异值方向上的尺度差异，使更新更接近谱范数意义下的最速下降。直觉上这应当有利于低秩问题，但作者发现，在经典矩阵分解里，这种谱归一化并不天然优于坐标自适应；相反，AdamW 的逐坐标缩放在病态条件数下更直接。Muon 真正显出优势的地方，是 NMF 中它会抑制多个因子朝同一方向塌缩，减少冗余表示，促使因子更分散、更“去共线”。也就是说，Muon 的收益未必来自更快地拟合主奇异方向，而可能来自一种隐式的表示正则化。这个解释和它在深网里可能改善特征多样性、缓解表示退化的经验现象是相通的。
summary.experiments: 从全文给出的结论看，实验重点不是追求单一最好数值，而是比较不同问题结构下的相对排序。主要发现有四点。第一，在标准低秩矩阵分解上，Muon 的优势在公平调参后基本消失，AdamW 和 GD 可以达到相当甚至更好的收敛速度与最终误差。第二，在矩阵补全这类带采样缺失的问题上，Muon 同样没有表现出稳定领先，说明“梯度正交化自动更适合谱问题”这个直觉并不成立。第三，在 NMF 上，Muon 有更一致的优势，尤其是在过参数化或因子冗余更明显的设定下，能得到更好的重构和更少的因子重合。第四，病态条件数并不会自动把优势推向 Muon；很多情况下 AdamW 的自适应缩放更有效。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但正文的价值在于系统扫了条件数、参数化程度、任务变体，并把结论建立在 tuned comparison 上，而不是单点实验。对研究者来说，最该看的不是某个提升百分点，而是“哪类问题 Muon 不赢、哪类问题它才开始赢”这个边界。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 里的三个研究问题和 findings，再看实验主表与不同任务设定的对比图，最后补 Appendix 中 Muon 机制说明和 bilinear / completion 变体。预计 20 到 30 分钟能抓住主线。阅读时重点留意两件事：一是作者如何定义“公平比较”，包括超参搜索和预算控制；二是 NMF 里对因子冗余、表示多样性的解释，这部分比单纯的 loss 排名更有启发。如果你关心 Muon 能否迁移到 LLM 预训练 recipe，值得把这篇和大规模 Muon 经验论文对照着看：这里提供的是失败案例和适用边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a cleaner question than “does Muon help on large models?”: once architecture, data, and scale confounders are removed, where does Muon itself actually help. The authors use low-rank matrix factorization, matrix completion, and nonnegative matrix factorization as controlled testbeds to examine whether Muon’s orthogonalized update truly exploits spectral structure and improves optimization under ill-conditioning, or whether its gains in LLM training are tied to deep-network-specific dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is that it deconfounds a popular optimizer. Much of the excitement around Muon comes from GPT-style training, where optimizer effects are entangled with depth, normalization, data mixture, and large-batch behavior. The conclusion here is measured: on standard low-rank factorization and matrix completion, Muon’s reported gains largely disappear under fair tuning, and AdamW or even GD can match or beat it; Muon shows a more consistent advantage mainly in NMF-like settings where redundant factors compete and representation diversity matters. For LLM pretraining, that means Muon should not be read as a uniformly better drop-in replacement. It looks more like an optimizer with preferences for certain geometries.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is not a new optimizer but a tightly controlled reassessment. The setup has three important pieces. First, the authors choose problem families that can be systematically swept: symmetric PSD factorization, matrix completion, and NMF. These cover unconstrained low-rank recovery, missing-observation settings, and constrained factorization with nonnegativity and redundancy. Second, they run equal-budget, carefully tuned comparisons across Muon, Adam, AdamW, and GD, instead of inheriting community-default hyperparameters. This matters because Muon is sensitive to learning rate, momentum, weight decay, and the approximation details of the orthogonalization step. Third, they interpret results through the lens of what orthogonalization is actually doing. Muon approximately orthogonalizes matrix-shaped gradients, flattening singular-value anisotropy and moving closer to steepest descent under the spectral norm. One might expect that to help on spectral problems, but the paper shows that in classical matrix factorization this does not automatically beat coordinate-wise adaptivity; AdamW’s per-coordinate scaling is often more useful under ill-conditioning. Where Muon does help is NMF: orthogonalized updates appear to discourage factor collapse and reduce redundant directions, leading to more diverse factors. So the gain may come less from faster fitting of dominant singular directions and more from an implicit regularization effect on representation geometry.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental contribution is about relative behavior across regimes rather than a single headline number. Four findings stand out. First, on standard low-rank matrix factorization, Muon’s advantage mostly vanishes after fair tuning, with AdamW and GD reaching similar or better convergence and final error. Second, on matrix completion, Muon again does not show a stable lead, which weakens the simple intuition that spectral normalization should automatically help on spectrally structured tasks. Third, on NMF, Muon shows a more consistent advantage, especially in overparameterized settings or when factor redundancy is more severe, yielding better reconstruction and less factor overlap. Fourth, ill-conditioning alone does not hand the win to Muon; in many cases AdamW’s adaptive scaling remains stronger. The abstract truncates before detailed numbers, but the full paper’s value is the systematic sweep over conditioning, parameterization, and task variants, with conclusions grounded in tuned comparisons rather than one-off runs.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the Introduction and the three motivating questions, then read the main experimental figures and tables comparing tasks and regimes, and finally check the appendix sections that describe Muon and the bilinear/completion variants. About 20–30 minutes is enough to get the main message. Pay attention to two things: how the paper defines a fair optimizer comparison, including hyperparameter search and budget control; and how it explains Muon’s advantage in NMF through reduced redundancy and increased factor diversity. If you care about whether Muon should enter an LLM pretraining recipe, this paper is useful precisely because it maps out where Muon does not win.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不会直接给你新 recipe，但会压低你对 Muon 神效的先验；重点看它如何做 clean control，适合拿来校正内部 optimizer ablation 的口径。
recommendation.en: It will not hand you a new recipe, but it should lower your prior on Muon hype; read it for the clean control logic and use it to tighten internal optimizer ablations.

paper.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
paper.abstract: Most reported gains from agent-optimization methods are one-shot: an agent is optimized against a fixed benchmark and the resulting improvement is reported as if it were a stable property of the method. This does not test the setting that matters for deployed agents, where optimization is applied recursively as new failures and new tasks appear over time. The central question this raises is whether optimizer-driven gains compound: after an agent has been optimized once, can it be optimized again

summary.core_problem: 检验 agent optimizer 在持续到来的新任务上是否能“复利式”累积收益，而不是只在一次性静态 benchmark 上看起来有效。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测设定而不是新 agent 方法。它把 agent 优化从单阶段静态评测改成两阶段 continual-learning 评测，直接暴露现有优化器是否会遗忘旧收益。这对看 agent scaling、test-time optimization 和部署稳定性的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Terminal-Bench 2.0 构建两阶段 continual-learning evaluation，在相同优化预算下比较 GEPA、Meta Harness 和 RELAI-VCL 三类 agent-harness optimization 方法。重点不是提出新优化器，而是控制预算与任务到达顺序，观察第一轮优化后的收益在第二轮新任务到来后能否保留、迁移或被侵蚀。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明三种方法在传统单阶段静态设定下都优于 baseline agent，但在引入新任务后的持续学习设定中，收益不再稳定累积，部分方法出现旧任务收益回退或新旧任务兼顾失败。由于摘要未给出具体数值、agent backbone 和任务规模，当前更应把它当作评测协议信号，而不是结论终局。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Soheil Feizi。Feizi 在鲁棒性、评测与模型行为分析方面有较强辨识度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether gains from agent optimizers actually compound when new tasks arrive over time, instead of merely looking good in a one-shot static benchmark setting.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol, not a new agent method. By turning agent optimization into a two-phase continual-learning test, it exposes whether current optimizers preserve earlier gains or simply overfit to a fixed benchmark. This is relevant for people tracking agent scaling, test-time optimization, and deployment stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on Terminal-Bench 2.0, the paper introduces a two-phase continual-learning evaluation and compares GEPA, Meta Harness, and RELAI-VCL under matched optimization budgets. The point is not to invent another optimizer, but to control budget and task arrival so one can measure whether improvements from phase one survive phase two.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, all three methods beat the baseline agent in the conventional single-phase static setting. Once new tasks are introduced, however, the gains do not reliably compound, and some methods appear to lose prior improvements or fail to balance old and new tasks. Since the abstract omits exact numbers, backbone details, and task counts, the result should be treated as a strong evaluation signal rather than a settled empirical law.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Soheil Feizi, who is well known for work on robustness, evaluation, and model behavior analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是新 agent 算法，而是把“优化有效”这件事测得更干净；若你关心 test-time scaling 或 agent 训练闭环，只看设定和主表即可。
recommendation.en: Not a new agent algorithm, but a cleaner way to test whether optimization really sticks; if you care about test-time scaling or agent training loops, the setup and main table are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Same Loss, Same Noise, Opposite Schedules: Noise Structure and Optimizer Normalization Jointly Determine Whether Learning-Rate Cooldown Helps
paper.abstract: The cooldown phase of a warmup-stable-decay (WSD) learning-rate schedule, now a default in large-model pretraining, lowers the final training loss in some settings and does nothing in others. We give a provable account of which case obtains, and it turns on two properties together: the structure of the gradient noise and whether the optimizer normalizes its update. On a strongly convex objective with multiplicative (gradient-proportional) noise, stochastic gradient descent contracts geometricall

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文回答一个对 LLM 预训练很实际的问题：WSD 学习率日程里的 cooldown 为什么有时能降低最终 loss，有时几乎没有效果。关键结论是，答案不只取决于 loss landscape 或噪声大小，而取决于两件事的组合：梯度噪声是乘性还是加性，以及优化器的 update magnitude 是否会随着梯度变小而自然变小。
summary.importance: 这是 must-read，因为它把 cooldown 从经验 recipe 拆成了可验证的机制。LLM 预训练中常用 Adam、AdamW、Adafactor 等自适应方法，这类方法在很多分析里可近似为 normalized 或 sign-like update：方向来自梯度，步长幅度不完全随梯度范数收缩。论文说明，在纯乘性噪声下，SGD 会 self-anneal，固定学习率已经能几何收敛；但 normalized 方法不会 self-anneal，会停在 Θ(η²) 的 last-iterate loss floor，因此需要 cooldown 把 η 降下来。这个结论不能直接给出大模型最佳 cooldown fraction，但它解释了为什么同一 loss、同一噪声下，换优化器会改变 cooldown 是否有用。对预训练实验设计的影响是明确的：分析 schedule 时不能只看 learning rate curve，也要测量噪声结构和 update normalization。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 separable strongly convex quadratic 入手，使用 affine-variance 噪声模型：梯度噪声方差由 σ0² + σ1²||∇f||² 控制。σ0 是加性噪声项，在 optimum 处仍存在；σ1 是乘性噪声项，随梯度一起消失。对于 σ0=0 的乘性噪声，SGD 的二阶矩满足完全乘性递推：m_{t+1}=r(η)m_t，其中 r(η)=(1-ηλ)²+η²σ1²λ²。最优固定步长是 η*=1/(λ(1+σ1²))，此时收缩因子为 σ1²/(1+σ1²)，固定学习率就是固定 horizon 下的最优 schedule，WSD cooldown fraction 的最优值为 0。相反，对 signSGD 或 normalized methods，乘性噪声下“走对方向”的概率与当前位置尺度无关。即使靠近 minimizer，更新步长仍由 η 控制，而不会随梯度范数自然缩小，所以动力学变成可解析的 lattice walk，并出现 Θ(η²) 的 last-iterate loss floor。只要存在加性噪声 σ0>0，所有方法都会出现 η 相关的 floor。论文还把结论扩展到局部 (L0,L1)-smooth setting、多维 normalized SGD、momentum、以及 heavy-tailed 噪声；其中 heavy-tail 部分强调分类不依赖有限矩假设。
summary.experiments: 实验主要验证理论预测，而不是追求大规模预训练结果。论文报告了多组 simulation，包括 quadratic 设置和 nonconvex deep linear network 上的 WSD sweep，用来检查 cooldown fraction 与最终 last-iterate loss 的关系。理论预测包括：SGD 在纯乘性噪声下偏好 constant schedule，cooldown 不改善最后 loss；sign/normalized 更新在相同 loss 和噪声下存在 η² 量级 floor，降低最终学习率会改善最后 iterate；加入加性噪声后，SGD 也会出现需要小 η 才能压低的噪声 floor。论文还在真实分类任务上直接测量噪声结构和 schedule preference，并用 Figure 1 和 Figure 2 展示预测与观测的一致性。需要注意，文中没有声称这些实验复现 LLM 预训练尺度，而是把它们作为机制验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction，把问题限定为 last-iterate effect：cooldown 改善最终 iterate，不一定改善训练过程中见过的最好 loss。然后读 Setup 和 noise model，确认 σ0 与 σ1 的含义；这是理解全文的入口。Prop. 1 是 SGD self-annealing 的核心，重点看 m_t 的乘性递推和 η* 的推导。Lemma 1、Prop. 2 和相关 remark 是 normalized methods 的核心，重点看为什么 correct-step probability 与 iterate scale 无关，以及为什么这会产生 Θ(η²) floor。Prop. 3 用来理解加性噪声如何改变所有方法的结论。Section 6–9 可按需读，重点是哪些假设被放宽：非二次局部光滑、多维、momentum、heavy tails。Section 10 的模拟和真实分类任务值得看图和实验设置。Section 11 也要读，它界定了这套机制不能解释的部分，尤其是大模型里 cooldown 长度、数据顺序、batch size、AdamW 细节和非平稳训练动态。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when the cooldown phase in a warmup-stable-decay schedule actually improves the final iterate. The answer depends on a joint condition: the structure of gradient noise and whether the optimizer’s update magnitude shrinks with the gradient. Holding the loss and the noise fixed, changing the optimizer can flip cooldown from unnecessary to useful.
summary_en.importance: This is a high-value paper for pretraining research because it gives a mechanistic account of a schedule choice that is now common in large-model training. The result is especially relevant to Adam-like optimizers, which often behave more like normalized or sign-based methods than plain SGD in simplified analyses. Under purely multiplicative noise, SGD self-anneals and a constant learning rate is already optimal for the last iterate. Normalized methods do not self-anneal; they hit a last-iterate loss floor of order η² and need cooldown to lower that floor. The paper does not solve the optimal cooldown fraction for LLM-scale training, but it gives a concrete diagnostic: schedule effects should be analyzed together with noise structure and optimizer normalization, not from the learning-rate curve alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts with a separable strongly convex quadratic and an affine-variance noise model, where the gradient-noise variance has an additive term σ0² and a multiplicative term σ1²||∇f||². When σ0=0, the noise is a scale family and vanishes at the optimum. For SGD in one coordinate, the second moment follows an exactly multiplicative recursion with contraction r(η)=(1-ηλ)²+η²σ1²λ². The optimal fixed learning rate is η*=1/(λ(1+σ1²)), giving contraction σ1²/(1+σ1²), and the best WSD cooldown fraction is zero. For signSGD and normalized methods under the same multiplicative noise, the probability of stepping in the correct direction is independent of the iterate scale. The dynamics reduce to an analyzable lattice walk, producing a final loss floor of Θ(η²). Cooldown helps because it reduces the step granularity. With any additive noise component, σ0>0, every method has an η-dependent floor. The paper then checks robustness under local (L0,L1)-smoothness, multidimensional normalized SGD, momentum, and heavy-tailed noise without relying on finite moments.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed to test the mechanism rather than to train large language models. Simulations on the quadratic setting verify the quantitative predictions for SGD and normalized/sign-like methods. WSD sweeps on a nonconvex deep linear network reproduce the optimizer-dependent schedule preference: SGD under multiplicative noise does not benefit from cooldown, while normalized updates do because their last-iterate loss is limited by a step-size floor. Adding an additive noise component restores a floor for all methods. The paper also measures noise structure and schedule preference directly on a real classification task, with the key observations shown in Figures 1 and 2. The empirical section supports the theory’s qualitative split, while leaving LLM-scale cooldown length and nonstationary training effects outside its claims.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the introduction’s framing of cooldown as a last-iterate effect, since this explains why min-over-iterates analyses miss the phenomenon. Then read the setup and noise model to separate additive noise from multiplicative noise. Proposition 1 is the central result for SGD: focus on the multiplicative second-moment recursion and the derivation of η*. Lemma 1 and Proposition 2 are the central results for normalized methods: focus on the scale-invariance of the correct-step probability and the resulting Θ(η²) floor. Proposition 3 explains why additive noise changes the conclusion for all optimizers. Sections 6–9 are useful for checking which assumptions are essential and which are not. Section 10 is worth reading with the figures open. Section 11 is important because it states the limits of the mechanism, including what it does not explain about real LLM pretraining schedules.

recommendation.zh: 把cooldown效果与优化器类型、噪声结构绑定的机制解释很干净，应立刻在内部小模型上验证归一化优化器下cooldown的收益幅度。
recommendation.en: The mechanism linking cooldown benefit to optimizer normalization and noise structure is clean; immediately validate cooldown gain magnitude with normalized optimizers in small-scale internal runs.

paper.title: M+Adam: Low-Precision Training via Additive-Multiplicative Optimization
paper.abstract: Training with quantized weights can reduce costs but often results in degraded accuracy, especially when optimization is carried out in low precision, without storing high-precision copies. We identify a key failure mode: under low precision, standard optimizers can get stuck and not make progress, especially at large weight magnitudes due to coarse mantissa resolution. To overcome this, multiplicative updates have been previously proposed, in place of additive updates in standard optimizers. Wh

summary.core_problem: 在不保留高精度 master weights 的前提下，如何让大模型在 BF16/FP8/FP4 等低精度权重存储下仍能稳定优化；并解决标准 AdamW 的“更新被量化舍入为 0（尤其在大权重幅值处）”与纯乘法更新（Madam）的“过零/符号翻转与零点逃逸失败”这两类互补失效模式。
summary.importance: 这是典型的“训练 recipe/优化器”类工作，直接指向预训练成本结构：如果 master weights 也能降到 BF16/FP8/NVFP4 且不依赖 stochastic rounding，还能保持接近全精度的收敛，就能显著降低显存与带宽压力。论文把低精度训练的关键障碍明确为“浮点非均匀网格导致的有效步长消失”，并给出一个组合式更新规则与单调下降性质证明，工程可用性较强。对做大规模预训练系统的人，这类结论通常比小改 loss 更可迁移。
summary.technical_approach:
M+Adam 的核心是把“加法更新”和“乘法更新”并联，再按规则合成一次权重更新：
- 加法分支：基本沿用 Adam/AdamW 的动量与二阶矩估计，在权重空间做 u^(a) 的加性步进。它的优势是能在接近 0 的区域产生有效绝对位移、支持符号翻转；但在低精度浮点下，当 |w| 很大时，局部量化 bin 变粗，小更新会被舍入掉，出现卡死。
- 乘法分支：借鉴 Madam 的思想做相对尺度更新（w ← w * (1 - η * a) 这类形式），使步长与 |w| 成比例，从而在大幅值区域仍能跨过量化台阶；但它天然难以穿越 0、也无法从精确的 w=0 初始化中“动起来”。

论文进一步把乘法分支写成“对 exponent 的梯度更新”：利用浮点分解 w = m * 2^e，把关于 e 的梯度 g^(e) 写成不显式依赖 e 的形式，再对 g^(e) 做二阶矩归一化，得到相对更新量。实现上加入阈值 τ 防止除以极小权重、并对相对因子做 clipping，避免数值爆炸。

合成策略的直觉是：在大幅值区主要依赖乘法分支跨量化格点，在小幅值/过零区依赖加法分支完成精细调整与符号变化。论文还给出在标准光滑性假设下的 monotone descent 证明，至少从理论上保证它不是“拍脑袋的混合”。
summary.experiments:
论文声称覆盖的规模与设置比较贴近预训练：
- 模型：60M–1B 的 LLaMA-style 模型。
- 训练预算：1–8× Chinchilla budgets。
- 精度：BF16、FP8、NVFP4 作为 master weights（强调不保留 FP32 master）。
- 对比：AdamW、AdamW + stochastic rounding（SR）、以及 Madam 等。
- 结论：M+Adam 在上述低精度 master weights 下可稳定训练，不需要 SR，并在收敛/最终效果上优于 AdamW 与 AdamW+SR。

你提供的全文片段未包含 Table 2 等具体数值（loss/perplexity 差距、稳定性失败率、吞吐/显存节省），因此无法安全复述精确提升幅度；但从问题设定与对比项看，重点应是“避免卡死 + 不靠 SR”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction + Fig.1/2（若在 PDF 中）：理解低精度浮点的非均匀量化网格如何让 AdamW 在大 |w| 区域更新消失，以及 Madam 在 0 附近/符号翻转的结构性问题。
- 精读方法部分对“exponent 梯度”的推导与 τ、clipping 的工程细节；这些决定了它在 FP8/FP4 下是否真的稳。
- 看 toy example（文中提到 Sec.5.1）：通常最能直观看到两类 failure mode 的互补性。
- 最后看 Table 2 及不同精度/不同预算下的稳定性对照：关注是否存在需要调参才能稳、以及对学习率/weight decay 的敏感性。

summary_en.core_problem: How to train large models with low-precision stored weights (BF16/FP8/FP4 master weights) without keeping high-precision master copies, while avoiding two complementary optimizer failure modes: (1) additive AdamW updates getting rounded to zero at large |w| due to coarse mantissa resolution, and (2) purely multiplicative updates (Madam) failing near zero and across sign changes.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining-optimizer/recipe contribution with direct systems implications: if master weights can be reduced to BF16/FP8/NVFP4 without stochastic rounding and without convergence collapse, memory and bandwidth costs drop materially. The paper frames the core obstacle as “vanishing effective step size on a non-uniform floating-point grid” and proposes a combined update rule with a monotone-descent guarantee, which makes it more actionable than ad-hoc heuristics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
M+Adam combines two update branches:
- Additive branch: Adam/AdamW-style moment estimates and an additive step in weight space. This is crucial near zero and for sign flips, but in low precision it can stall at large magnitudes because updates smaller than the local quantization bin are rounded away.
- Multiplicative branch: Madam-style relative (scale) updates so the effective step scales with |w|, helping the optimizer move on coarse grids at large magnitudes. But multiplicative updates preserve sign and cannot escape exact zeros.

A notable detail is the derivation of the multiplicative branch via exponent-space gradients: using floating-point decomposition w = m·2^e, the method expresses the gradient w.r.t. the exponent in a form that does not require explicitly tracking e, then applies second-moment normalization. Practical safeguards include a threshold τ to avoid division by tiny weights and clipping of relative factors.

The combination is designed so multiplicative updates dominate where quantization bins are large, while additive updates handle the near-zero and sign-change regime. The paper also provides a monotone descent proof under standard smoothness assumptions.
summary_en.experiments:
Claimed experimental coverage is aligned with LLM pretraining settings:
- Models: 60M to 1B LLaMA-style.
- Budgets: 1–8× Chinchilla training budgets.
- Precisions: BF16, FP8, NVFP4 master weights (no FP32 master).
- Baselines: AdamW, AdamW + stochastic rounding, and Madam.
- Reported outcome: stable training across these precisions without stochastic rounding, and better convergence than AdamW / AdamW+SR.

The provided excerpt does not include the key tables/figures (e.g., Table 2) with exact metrics, so I cannot quote precise deltas or failure rates without the missing pages.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the motivation figures (quantization-bin intuition) to internalize why additive vs multiplicative updates fail in complementary regimes.
- Read the exponent-gradient derivation and the implementation safeguards (τ, clipping); these details determine whether FP8/FP4 training is actually robust.
- Check the toy example section (mentioned as Sec. 5.1) to see the failure modes in isolation.
- Then go to the main tables comparing BF16/FP8/NVFP4 master weights across budgets; focus on stability, sensitivity to hyperparameters, and whether SR is truly unnecessary.

recommendation.zh: 低精度训练优化器的务实改进，加性乘性互补的思路值得在内部预训练低精度消融中验证，重点看理论收敛性与精度tradeoff
recommendation.en: A pragmatic low-precision optimizer improvement; test the additive-multiplicative complementarity in internal pretraining ablations, focus on convergence guarantees and accuracy tradeoffs

paper.title: No Subspace to Track: Non-Identifiability and Optimizer State in Low-Rank Training
paper.abstract: Memory-efficient optimizers such as GaLore train large language models by projecting gradients onto a rank-r subspace recomputed every T steps, assuming this subspace is a slowly drifting object that can be tracked. We show that beyond a small reproducible core, there is no such object. Two estimates of the top-r subspace computed at the same step from disjoint minibatches disagree as much as estimates computed T steps apart (0.73 vs 0.74 of the maximal chordal distance sqrt(2r), at Pythia-160M

summary.core_problem: 以GaLore为代表的低秩梯度优化器通过将梯度投影到低秩子空间来节省优化器内存，其核心前提假设是——梯度的top-r主奇异子空间是缓慢漂移的、可被跟踪的稳定对象，但这一假设从未经过严格的实证测量；若假设不成立，优化器状态在子空间刷新时的传递将失去依据，进而影响训练效率与效果。
summary.importance: 是低秩梯度优化领域的基础性修正工作。其一，证伪了"低秩子空间缓慢漂移"的核心前提，证明观测到的子空间旋转本质是估计噪声而非真实运动；其二，从梯度谱的幂律特性出发解释了子空间非可辨识性的根源，以及低秩优化器仍然有效的机制；其三，给出了两种可落地的优化器改进路径，对大模型内存高效训练、低秩训练方法设计有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach:
核心方法是通过弦距离量化子空间差异，并设计了关键的同步控制实验：在同一训练步用两个不相交的小批次分别估计top-r子空间，比较二者的差异与相隔一个刷新间隔T的子空间差异，以区分「真实漂移」和「估计噪声」。
核心发现包括：1. 训练中每次子空间刷新时，新旧子空间的弦距离达到几何最大值的96.7%–99.6%，几乎正交；2. 同步两个子空间的差异（0.725√(2r)）与相隔T步的差异（0.742√(2r)）几乎相当，说明子空间的变化主要由估计噪声主导；3. 梯度谱仅包含少量可复现的主导方向（r=128时仅约39个），其后是无间隙的平滑幂律尾部，top-r截断位于体谱内部，相邻奇异值比仅约1.005，根据Davis-Kahan定理，子空间估计具有内在随机性；4. 平均梯度无法打开谱隙，因为尾部是幂律信号而非纯噪声，收缩速度仅为N^(-1/4)，无法通过增加平均量让子空间稳定。
基于上述发现提出两种改进路径：一是通过旋转矩阵传输优化器状态（结合误差反馈的LDAdam方法），二是减小Adam的二阶矩衰减系数β2以缩短记忆长度，适配较短的子空间刷新间隔。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖四个模型家族、三类架构，参数规模从70M到6.9B，核心结果包括：
1. 子空间一致性测量：在Pythia-160M上，r=128时，同步两批次子空间的弦距离为0.725√(2r)，相隔一个刷新间隔（160M训练步）的子空间弦距离为0.742√(2r)，二者差异不足3%；训练中每次刷新的子空间旋转达到最大弦距离的96.7%–99.6%，在r=32到256范围内均成立。
2. 可复现方向数：r=128时，仅约39个奇异方向在同步两批次间一致。
3. 谱特性：r=128时，top-r子空间仅包含46%–68%的梯度核质量，相邻奇异值比约为1.005。
4. 平均基的效果：在Pythia-1B上，平均一万步的子空间仍有84%的最大旋转（无平均时为97%），最终困惑度在四个数量级的平均窗口内仅波动0.36，几乎无改善。
5. 改进方法效果：在Pythia-1B上，状态传输的LDAdam在默认β2=0.999时达到18.73的困惑度，优于未传输的GaLore在最优β2下的19.28；将β2从0.999降至0.99，对低秩优化器可带来1.8到26的困惑度提升（因优化器和配置而异），而全秩Adam上则出现相反的效果，明确了子空间重绘是性能损失的根源。
summary.reading_guide:
精读重点：
- 第2节：子空间测量方法与同步控制实验设计，是整篇工作的核心论证基础，关注弦距离的定义和同步对比的实验逻辑；
- 第3节：谱分析与非可辨识性的成因，重点理解梯度幂律尾部、Davis-Kahan定理的应用，以及平均无法改善稳定性的原因；
- 第4节：低秩优化器仍然有效的机制解释；
- 第5节：两种改进方案（状态传输、调整β2）的原理与消融实验，关注状态传输的理论误差边界。
值得深挖的方向：低秩训练的有效秩与模型规模/训练阶段的关系、幂律谱特性对LoRA等其他低秩方法的普适性、状态传输方法在超大规模模型上的scaling效果、梯度子空间的可复现核心与训练动力学的关联。

summary_en.core_problem: Low-rank gradient optimizers like GaLore reduce optimizer memory footprint by projecting gradients onto a low-rank subspace, resting on the untested core assumption that the top-r singular subspace of gradients is a slowly drifting, trackable stable object. If this assumption fails, transferring optimizer state across subspace refreshes loses its justification, hurting training efficiency and performance.
summary_en.importance: A foundational corrective work in the field of low-rank gradient optimization. First, it falsifies the core premise of a 'slowly drifting low-rank subspace', proving that observed subspace rotation is dominated by estimation noise rather than real motion. Second, it explains the root of subspace non-identifiability from the power-law properties of gradient spectra, and the mechanism by which low-rank optimizers still work despite this issue. Third, it proposes two practical improvement paths for optimizers, with direct guidance for memory-efficient training of large models and design of low-rank training methods.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method quantifies subspace difference via chordal distance, and introduces a critical same-step control experiment: at the same training step, two disjoint minibatches are used to estimate the top-r subspace separately, and their difference is compared with the subspace difference across one refresh interval T to disentangle 'real drift' from 'estimation noise'.
Key findings include: 1. During training, the chordal distance between new and old subspaces at each refresh reaches 96.7%–99.6% of the geometric maximum, nearly orthogonal. 2. The difference between two same-step subspaces (0.725√(2r)) is nearly equivalent to the difference across T steps (0.742√(2r)), indicating subspace variation is dominated by estimation noise. 3. The gradient spectrum contains only a small number of reproducible dominant directions (~39 at r=128), followed by a gapless smooth power-law tail. The top-r cutoff lies inside the bulk spectrum, with an adjacent singular value ratio of only ~1.005; per the Davis-Kahan theorem, subspace estimation has inherent randomness. 4. Averaging gradients cannot open a spectral gap, as the tail is power-law signal rather than pure noise, shrinking only as N^(-1/4), so subspace stability cannot be achieved by increasing averaging budget.
Two improvement paths are proposed based on these findings: first, transporting optimizer state via rotation matrices (the LDAdam method with error feedback), and second, reducing Adam's second-moment decay coefficient β2 to shorten memory length and match the short subspace refresh interval.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments cover four model families, three architecture classes, with parameter scales from 70M to 6.9B. Core results include:
1. Subspace consistency measurement: On Pythia-160M with r=128, the chordal distance between two same-step minibatch subspaces is 0.725√(2r), while the distance across one refresh interval (160M training steps) is 0.742√(2r), a difference of less than 3%. Per-refresh subspace rotation reaches 96.7%–99.6% of maximum chordal distance during training, consistent across r from 32 to 256.
2. Reproducible direction count: Only ~39 singular directions are consistent across two same-step minibatches when r=128.
3. Spectral properties: At r=128, the top-r subspace contains only 46%–68% of the gradient's nuclear mass, with an adjacent singular value ratio of ~1.005.
4. Effect of basis averaging: On Pythia-1B, a subspace averaged over 10,000 steps still exhibits 84% of maximum rotation (97% without averaging), and final perplexity fluctuates by only 0.36 across four orders of magnitude of averaging window size, showing negligible improvement.
5. Improvement method performance: On Pythia-1B, state-transported LDAdam reaches 18.73 perplexity at default β2=0.999, outperforming untransported GaLore's 19.28 at its best β2. Reducing β2 from 0.999 to 0.99 brings 1.8 to 26 perplexity improvement for low-rank optimizers (varies by optimizer and recipe), while the opposite effect is seen on full-rank Adam, confirming subspace redraw as the root cause of performance loss.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Key sections for close reading:
- Section 2: Subspace measurement method and same-step control experiment design, the core argumentative foundation. Focus on the definition of chordal distance and the logic of same-step comparison.
- Section 3: Spectral analysis and causes of non-identifiability. Focus on the gradient power-law tail, application of the Davis-Kahan theorem, and why averaging fails to improve stability.
- Section 4: Mechanistic explanation of why low-rank optimizers remain effective despite non-identifiable subspaces.
- Section 5: Principles and ablation experiments of the two improvement schemes (state transport, β2 adjustment). Focus on the theoretical error bound of state transport.
Worth further exploration: the relationship between effective rank in low-rank training and model scale/training stage, the generality of power-law spectral properties for other low-rank methods like LoRA, scaling effects of state transport on ultra-large models, and the connection between the reproducible core of gradient subspaces and training dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻对内部低秩优化器复现同步 minibatch 子空间检验；它改变的是“可追踪低秩子空间”这个解释 prior。
recommendation.en: Run the same-minibatch subspace test on any internal low-rank optimizer; this directly weakens the prior that there is a trackable low-rank gradient subspace.

paper.title: Token Geometry
paper.abstract: Language models learn continuous programs over discrete symbols, with the embedding table and LM-head acting as the read/write interface between them. We show that this interface has gradient geometry distinct from dense hidden weights which can be exploited to improve the Pareto frontier across supervised finetuning, RL, and pretraining, while only utilizing kilobytes of optimizer state. We introduce Ember, a lightweight optimizer for embedding and LM-head matrices that utilizes O(V + D) VRAM,

summary.core_problem: Transformer的输入嵌入表和输出LM头（统称token接口参数）目前普遍使用Adam优化，显存开销为O(2VD)，需要复杂的分布式分片工程。现有主流优化器改进（如Muon）几乎都仅针对稠密线性层，未覆盖token接口参数，也未利用其与交叉熵损失绑定的独特梯度几何结构（Fisher信息度量），导致显存浪费与工程冗余。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的具体影响分为两部分：一是工程层面，提出的Ember优化器将token接口的优化器显存开销从O(2VD)降至O(V+D)，典型大词表场景下仅需KB级状态，完全消除了嵌入表优化器状态的分片需求，可直接嵌入现有预训练、SFT、RL全流程，在不损失精度的前提下优化训练Pareto边界。二是理论层面，统一了Adam、Muon、Lion等主流Transformer优化器的底层逻辑——本质都是利用Fisher度量的平方根对梯度做归一化（等价于将梯度转换为z-score），为后续优化器研究提供了一致的数学框架。
summary.technical_approach: 首先建立统一理论视角：交叉熵损失的二阶导数恰好等于梯度的平方（即Fisher信息度量，也是KL散度唯一的规范局部几何结构），现有高性能Transformer优化器均等价于用Fisher度量的平方根对梯度做条件缩放，对应除以梯度估计的标准差。基于此设计Ember优化器，核心有两点：1. 完全移除Adam的一阶矩指数移动平均（EMA），直接使用瞬时梯度，消融实验证明该改动反而提升性能，同时节省V×D的显存；2. 观察到token接口参数的行梯度能量是token出现概率p_i的无偏估计，且行级Fisher与p_i²成正比，因此无需存储全量V×D的二阶矩缓冲，仅需维护V个行级与D个列级的二阶矩EMA即可近似曲率。与同类方法的区别：Adafactor虽也做二阶矩分解，但超参更多且未针对token接口的几何特性设计；Muon仅适用于线性层，依赖奇异值分解，无法直接用于嵌入表。
summary.experiments: 实验验证了三个核心结论：1. Ember在预训练、SFT、RL三个阶段均达到与Adam相当或更优的精度，同时优化训练的显存-精度Pareto边界；2. 扩展性验证：Ember的性能随batch size和参数量扩大保持稳定，无退化；3. 消融实验：移除一阶矩EMA可稳定提升性能（对应Figure 11），行/列分解的二阶矩近似与全量V×D缓冲效果相当。典型场景下（词表V=128k，隐藏维度D=5120），Adam的token接口优化器状态约5GB，Ember仅需约1MB，显存开销降低3个数量级。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先级：1. 引言部分关于Fisher度量与现有优化器的统一推导（核心理论创新，厘清了Adam、Muon、Lion的共同底层逻辑）；2. 方法部分关于移除一阶矩EMA的依据、行/列二阶矩分解的数学推导，以及附录6.8中行级Fisher与token频率的定量关系证明；3. 实验部分三个训练阶段的Pareto曲线、不同规模下的扩展性结果；4. 附录中与Adafactor、Modula的对比分析，明确设计取舍。值得深挖的方向：该Fisher统一框架是否可推广到MoE门控参数、注意力投影层等其他参数类型；能否与Muon结合实现全参数的低显存优化；行/列分解在200k+超大词表、多语言语料下的鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: Transformer embedding tables and LM heads (collectively called token interface parameters) are currently optimized with Adam, which incurs O(2VD) VRAM overhead and requires complex distributed sharding engineering. Most recent optimizer improvements (e.g., Muon) only target dense linear layers, leaving token interfaces unaddressed and failing to exploit their unique gradient geometry tied to the Fisher information structure of cross-entropy loss, resulting in wasted memory and redundant engineering work.
summary_en.importance: The work delivers two layers of value for pretraining research: On the engineering side, the proposed Ember optimizer reduces token interface optimizer VRAM from O(2VD) to O(V+D) — kilobyte-scale state for typical large vocabularies — eliminating sharding requirements for embedding/LM head states and directly fitting into existing pretraining, SFT, and RL pipelines while improving the accuracy-memory Pareto frontier with no performance tradeoff. On the theoretical side, it unifies the underlying logic of mainstream Transformer optimizers (Adam, Muon, Lion) as instances of Fisher metric square-root normalization (equivalent to converting gradients to z-scores), providing a coherent mathematical framework for future optimizer research.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, a unified theoretical perspective is established: the second derivative of cross-entropy loss equals the squared gradient (Fisher information metric, the only canonical local geometry of KL divergence), and all high-performing Transformer optimizers effectively condition gradients by the square root of this metric, equivalent to dividing by the estimated standard deviation of gradient estimates. Ember is built on two core design choices: 1) Remove Adam's first-moment EMA entirely and use instantaneous gradients — ablation shows this change improves performance while saving V×D memory; 2) Leverage the observation that row-wise gradient energy of token interfaces is an unbiased estimator of token occurrence probability p_i, and row-wise Fisher scales with p_i², so full V×D second-moment buffers are unnecessary. Only V row-wise and D column-wise second-moment EMAs are maintained to approximate curvature. Key differences from prior work: Adafactor uses similar second-moment factorization but has more hyperparameters and is not purpose-built for token interface geometry; Muon only applies to linear layers and relies on singular value decomposition, making it unsuitable for embedding tables.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments confirm three core conclusions: 1) Ember matches or outperforms Adam across pretraining, SFT, and RL stages, improving the accuracy-memory Pareto frontier; 2) Scaling validation: Ember's performance remains stable as batch size and parameter count increase, with no degradation; 3) Ablation studies: removing first-moment EMA consistently improves performance (Figure 11), and row/column factorized second moments match the performance of full V×D buffers. For a typical large-vocabulary setup (V=128k, hidden dimension D=5120), Adam requires ~5GB of optimizer state for token interfaces, while Ember uses ~1MB — a 3-order-of-magnitude reduction in memory overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the following sections for deep reading: 1) The Introduction's unified derivation of existing optimizers under the Fisher metric (core theoretical contribution clarifying shared logic across Adam, Muon, Lion); 2) Methods sections covering first-moment removal justification, row/column second-moment factorization, plus Appendix 6.8 for the proof linking row-wise Fisher to token frequency; 3) Experimental Pareto curves across three training stages and scaling results across model sizes; 4) Appendix comparisons with Adafactor and Modula to contextualize design tradeoffs. Worth exploring further: whether the Fisher framework extends to MoE gating parameters and attention projection layers, whether Ember can combine with Muon for full-model low-memory optimization, and factorization robustness for 200k+ vocabularies and multilingual corpora.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看实验细节：若 1D token trajectory 站得住，词表矩阵的 Adam 状态可能不再值得付费。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental sections immediately: if the 1D token-trajectory claim holds, paying full Adam state for vocab matrices becomes hard to justify.

paper.title: Mixture-of-Parallelisms: Towards Memory-Efficient Training Stack for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: This paper showcases a memory-efficient training stack for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. It is a training paradigm that combines and specializes various existing and novel parallelism techniques at different layers and stages of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model training pipeline. It leverages these techniques to achieve maximal efficiency given the physical constraints of CPU, CPU memory, GPU HBM memory, and the CPU-GPU, GPU-GPU, and node-node communication bandwidth of the GPU cluster. It

summary.core_problem: 现有万亿参数长上下文MoE模型训练普遍采用全局统一的并行策略，无法匹配注意力、MoE前馈、词表投影、优化器状态等不同组件的差异化瓶颈，导致GPU显存、互联带宽、CPU/主机内存等资源利用率低，无法在有限硬件下支撑百万上下文的万亿参数训练。
summary.importance: 打破了全局统一并行策略的设计惯性，提出按组件瓶颈匹配并行方式的系统设计范式，大幅降低了万亿级MoE预训练与微调的硬件门槛；给出了长上下文MoE训练的内存-带宽瓶颈拆解方法，以及三个无损优化的具体实现，为后续大模型训练系统设计提供了可复用的组件级并行方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出混合并行（MoP）训练栈，放弃全局统一并行计划，为MoE模型的每个组件匹配对应瓶颈的分片策略，且所有并行方式在秩级别保持类数据并行特性（每个设备持有不同token分片和对应权重分片），避免3D并行的秩乘法开销。核心包含三个无损优化：1）基于最小负载专家并行（LLEP）的内存高效专家并行，将路由通信与专家计算重叠，降低MoE激活的瞬时内存占用同时保留LLEP的加速效果；2）数据-张量混合分片的词表投影，无需实例化O(NV)规模的logit张量即可计算精确损失和梯度，且满足类数据并行的秩不变性；3）流水线式优化器更新，通过计算-通信重叠压缩优化器步骤的关键路径耗时。所有优化均为无损，不改变训练语义。
summary.experiments: 在120B、600B、1T参数的MoE模型上分别用2、8、12台8×H200节点训练，与最优调参的FSDP2基线相比，MoP的单GPU吞吐量提升4.7~8.2倍，且模型规模越大优势越明显；FSDP2在上下文长度超过64K~128K时即显存耗尽，而MoP可稳定支持最高1M token的上下文训练，且吞吐量随上下文增长几乎保持平稳，万亿参数规模下每步耗时基本由前向/反向计算主导。
summary.reading_guide: 预计阅读时间20-25分钟。重点关注第3.1-3.2节的组件级瓶颈分析与并行策略匹配逻辑、第3.3-3.5节的三个核心无损优化的具体实现、第4节的不同规模模型与上下文长度下的吞吐量/内存对比图表；训练系统方向研究者可深挖附录中通信重叠的实现细节，预训练配方方向研究者可重点关注硬件资源利用率的拆解部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing trillion-parameter long-context MoE training relies on uniform global parallelism strategies that fail to match the distinct bottlenecks of different components (attention, MoE feed-forward, vocabulary projection, optimizer state), resulting in underutilization of GPU HBM, interconnect bandwidth, CPU/host memory, and making million-context trillion-parameter training infeasible on limited hardware budgets.
summary_en.importance: Breaks the conventional design inertia of uniform global parallelism, proposes a component-matched parallelism paradigm that drastically reduces the hardware barrier for trillion-scale MoE pretraining and fine-tuning. It also provides a structured memory-bandwidth bottleneck decomposition for long-context MoE training, along with three lossless optimizations that serve as reusable building blocks for future large model training system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Mixture-of-Parallelisms (MoP), a training stack that abandons uniform global parallel plans and assigns sharding strategies matched to each MoE component's dominant bottleneck. All composed parallelism methods maintain a data-parallel-like rank invariant (each device holds a distinct token shard and corresponding weight shard), avoiding the rank multiplication overhead of 3D parallelism. Three core lossless optimizations are included: 1) A memory-efficient expert parallelism built on Least-Loaded Expert Parallelism (LLEP) that overlaps routing communication with expert computation to reduce transient MoE activation footprint while preserving LLEP speedups; 2) A sharded data-tensor-parallel vocabulary projection that computes exact loss and gradients without materializing the O(NV) logit tensor, while respecting the data-parallel rank invariant; 3) A pipelined optimizer update scheme that compresses critical path time via computation-communication overlap. All optimizations preserve exact training semantics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 120B, 600B, and 1T parameter MoE models trained on 2, 8, and 12 8×H200 nodes respectively. Compared to the best-tuned FSDP2 baseline, MoP delivers 4.7–8.2× higher per-GPU throughput, with advantages widening as model scale grows. FSDP2 runs out of memory at context lengths beyond 64K–128K, while MoP stably supports up to 1M token context with nearly flat throughput across context lengths; per-step wall time at trillion-parameter scale is essentially bounded by forward and backward compute.
summary_en.reading_guide: Estimated reading time 20-25 minutes. Focus on Sections 3.1–3.2 for component-level bottleneck analysis and parallelism assignment logic, Sections 3.3–3.5 for implementation details of the three core lossless optimizations, and Section 4's throughput/memory comparison plots across model scales and context lengths. For training system researchers, deep dive into appendix communication overlap implementation details; for pretraining recipe researchers, focus on hardware resource utilization breakdowns.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型“系统细节决定能不能做实验”的 paper；先看并行分解和 optimizer step，若 loss 等价性证据干净，内部长上下文 MoE 栈应立刻对照复现。
recommendation.en: This is the kind of paper where systems detail determines whether the experiment is even feasible; read the parallelism decomposition and optimizer-step design first, then verify whether the loss-equivalence evidence is actually clean.

paper.title: SCAPE: Accurate and Efficient LLM Training with Extreme Sparse Communication
paper.abstract: Communication increasingly dominates the cost of Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training, especially under data-parallel and sharded training schemes, where gradient synchronization and parameter reconstruction overhead increase with model size and system scale. Existing communication-reduction methods either sparsify raw gradients, which can be unstable for modern Adam-style optimizers at high sparsity, or quantize communication, whose savings are fundamentally bounded by bit width and often in

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是大规模 LLM 训练中的通信瓶颈，尤其是数据并行和 ZeRO/FSDP/Megatron-LM 这类分片训练下的梯度同步与参数重构开销。作者关注的问题不是减少计算量，而是在不损害收敛和下游能力的前提下，把通信量压到很高稀疏度。传统 top-k 梯度稀疏在 AdamW 这类优化器上容易不稳定，量化通信又受 bit width 下限和实现开销限制，SCAPE 试图绕开这两个限制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在训练系统和优化器接口。它给出的信息是：通信压缩不一定要直接作用在 raw gradient 上，Adam 类优化器的动量状态可以提供更稳定的稀疏信号。这个方向对大规模预训练有实际意义，因为随着 GPU 数量增加，all-reduce、reduce-scatter、all-gather 会更早成为瓶颈。贡献量级属于工程上有用的分布式优化器改造，而不是训练目标或模型架构层面的变化。需要注意，实验规模是 GPT-345M 和 Llama-500M，结论还不能直接外推到数十亿到千亿参数训练；此外，误差反馈 buffer offload 依赖 GH200 的 CPU-GPU 高带宽连接，换到 PCIe 集群时收益可能下降。
summary.technical_approach: SCAPE 的核心做法是稀疏化优化器状态，而不是直接稀疏化当前 step 的原始梯度。作者基于 AdamS，而不是 AdamW。全文中的关键观察有两个：第一，在高稀疏通信下，AdamS 的残差增长比 AdamW 小，说明它对 error-feedback 中的 stale residual 更稳；第二，相邻训练 step 的一阶动量 top-k 结构有时间稳定性，因此 mask 可以延迟一个 step 使用。基于这两个观察，SCAPE 设计了 partitioned mask-refresh：每个分片根据动量统计生成稀疏 mask，mask 的同步与计算重叠，下一步再使用，避免把 mask 生成和通信放在 critical path 上。它还用一个同步后的 sparse buffer 重构二阶矩更新所需的量，避免额外的第二次 all-reduce。在 sharded data parallel 设置中，SCAPE 同时压缩梯度同步的 reduce-scatter 和参数重构的 all-gather，因此不是单点减少某个通信算子，而是沿着分片优化器的数据流做整体改造。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Megatron-LM 上实现，硬件是 TACC Vista supercomputer 的 GH200 GPU。作者预训练了 GPT-345M，数据为 OpenWebText；也预训练了 Llama-500M，数据为 SlimPajama-6B。主要数字来自 Llama-500M 在 32 张 GH200 上的训练：90% 稀疏度下 wall-clock time 降低 35.6%，99% 稀疏度下降低 43.3%。在这些高稀疏度下，最终 train loss 和 validation loss 与 dense AdamS、AdamW 接近。下游评测覆盖 LAMBADA、SuperGLUE、PIQA、MMLU、ARC，作者报告没有明显能力损失。论文还强调，相比基于 raw gradient 的 top-k 方法，SCAPE 在高稀疏下更稳定；相比 4-bit 或低 bit 量化方法，SCAPE 的通信削减不受 bit width 下界限制，但实现依赖稀疏通信和误差反馈管理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中关于通信瓶颈和 Figure 1 的设置，确认作者优化的是哪类并行模式。然后重点看 Background 里对 AdamS、top-k sparsification、Megatron distributed optimizer 的定义，否则后面的算法细节容易混。技术部分应重点看两个实证观察：AdamS 残差增长更小，以及一阶动量 top-k mask 的时间稳定性；这两个观察决定了为什么可以做 delayed mask reuse。算法部分重点看 partitioned mask-refresh、single sparse buffer 更新二阶矩、reduce-scatter/all-gather 的集成方式。实验部分建议优先看 sparsity sweep、loss curve、downstream benchmark 和 wall-clock breakdown；这些图表能判断收益来自通信减少，还是被 mask 生成、buffer offload、稀疏操作开销抵消。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the communication bottleneck in distributed LLM pretraining, especially gradient synchronization and parameter reconstruction under data parallel and sharded training schemes. The goal is not to reduce FLOPs, but to cut communication volume aggressively while preserving convergence and downstream quality. Existing top-k methods are brittle when applied to raw gradients with Adam-style optimizers, while quantization is bounded by bit width and can introduce nontrivial runtime overhead. SCAPE is designed to push sparsity much further without those failure modes.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is at the optimizer-system boundary for pretraining. The useful lesson is that communication sparsification does not have to operate on raw gradients; optimizer moments can provide a more stable signal for mask construction. This matters for large training runs because all-reduce, reduce-scatter, and all-gather become increasingly dominant as model and cluster sizes grow. The contribution is a practical distributed optimizer design rather than a new modeling objective or architecture. The evidence is still limited to GPT-345M and Llama-500M, so extrapolation to multi-billion or frontier-scale runs should be cautious. The implementation also benefits from GH200 CPU-GPU bandwidth for error-feedback buffer offload, which may not transfer cleanly to PCIe-based clusters.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCAPE sparsifies optimizer-state-derived quantities instead of raw gradients. It builds on AdamS rather than AdamW. Two observations drive the design. First, under high sparsity, AdamS shows much smaller residual growth than AdamW, suggesting better robustness to stale error-feedback dynamics. Second, the top-k structure of the first moment is stable across adjacent steps, making one-step delayed mask reuse practical. SCAPE therefore introduces a partitioned mask-refresh mechanism aligned with optimizer sharding. Masks are computed from momentum statistics, synchronized while computation proceeds, and used in the next step. The method also reconstructs the quantities needed for second-moment updates from a single synchronized sparse buffer, avoiding an additional all-reduce. In sharded data parallel training, the design compresses both reduce-scatter for gradient synchronization and all-gather for parameter reconstruction.
summary_en.experiments: The method is implemented in Megatron-LM and evaluated on the TACC Vista GH200 system. The paper pretrains GPT-345M on OpenWebText and Llama-500M on SlimPajama-6B. The headline result is for Llama-500M on 32 GH200 GPUs: 90% sparsity reduces wall-clock training time by 35.6%, and 99% sparsity reduces it by 43.3%. Final training and validation losses remain close to dense AdamS and AdamW. Downstream evaluation includes LAMBADA, SuperGLUE, PIQA, MMLU, and ARC, with no reported quality degradation. The experimental story also compares against raw-gradient sparsification and quantization-style methods, arguing that moment-based sparsity is more stable at extreme sparsity and that sparsity is not limited by a fixed bit-width floor.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the Introduction and Figure 1 to understand which communication paths are being optimized. Then read the Background definitions for AdamS, top-k sparsification, and Megatron distributed optimizers. The most important technical evidence is the pair of observations on AdamS residual growth and temporal stability of first-moment top-k masks. In the algorithm section, focus on partitioned mask refresh, delayed mask use, the single sparse buffer for second-moment reconstruction, and the integration with reduce-scatter and all-gather. In the experiments, prioritize sparsity sweeps, loss curves, downstream evaluation, and wall-clock breakdowns to see whether communication savings dominate the extra sparse-kernel and buffer-management costs.

recommendation.zh: 用一阶矩做稀疏掩码的思路干净且符合直觉，大规模训练中可直接尝试，重点看掩码生成和延迟同步的工程实现细节。
recommendation.en: Using first moments for sparse masking is a clean and intuitive idea worth trying in large-scale training; focus on mask generation and delayed synchronization implementation details.

paper.title: Muon as a Residual Connection
paper.abstract: Muon has recently emerged as one of the most effective optimizers for training large neural networks, yet its empirical success has been explained from several different perspectives. In this paper, we propose a simple mechanistic interpretation: Muon can be understood as an implicit residual connection during training. Specifically, orthogonalizing the update can sacrifice some immediate gradient fidelity while improving representation preservation for downstream layers. We study this trade-off

summary.core_problem: 现有对Muon优化器（大模型预训练中广泛采用的正交更新优化器）的解释多基于谱范数最陡下降、信任域、曲率等专业数学框架，缺乏基于深度学习社区通用知识的直观机制解释，也未从下游层表示可用性的角度解释其效果来源。
summary.importance: 该工作将优化器行为与架构设计（残差连接）建立关联，提供了全新的优化器设计视角——优化器不应仅追求局部梯度下降的保真度，还需平衡局部优化进度与下游层对表示的利用效率。这一思路可为深层Transformer（尤其是大模型预训练）的优化器设计提供启发，也能帮助理解Muon在大模型训练中相较于Adam系列优化器的稳定性与性能优势来源。
summary.technical_approach: 核心贡献是提出「Muon可被理解为隐式残差连接」的机制解释，与现有数学视角的解释形成互补：残差连接的核心作用是通过显式的正交（恒等映射是正交矩阵的特例）skip路径，为下游层同时提供保留的原始输入与变换后的表示；Muon的核心操作是将权重更新ΔW替换为与其最接近的正交矩阵Orth(ΔW)，相当于在优化轨迹中隐式注入正交变换的更新——二者逻辑一致，区别仅在于残差是架构层面的显式操作，Muon是优化层面的隐式操作。该工作进一步在受控线性优化场景下分析了二者的权衡（trade-off）关系：正交更新会牺牲少量局部目标的拟合速度（因未完全沿梯度方向更新），但能更好地保留表示的结构特性，提升下游层对表示的利用效率。
summary.experiments: 关键结果均来自受控线性多层优化场景的原理验证：1. 尽管Muon训练的局部层损失下降速度慢于标准梯度更新，但其生成的中间层表示在下游任务的线性探测精度更高；2. 当移除网络中的显式残差连接时，Muon的性能优势会进一步放大，验证了其确实能够补充残差连接的表示保留作用。未包含大模型预训练的具体实验（如参数量、数据规模、端到端性能提升幅度）。
summary.reading_guide: 预计阅读时间15-20分钟。泛读优先级：1. 引言部分：理解为何需要为Muon提出新的解释，以及现有解释的局限性；2. 「Muon作为隐式残差连接」的核心类比章节：重点理解线性层场景下，残差操作与Muon更新的数学对应关系；3. 受控线性场景的实验章节：验证表示保留与下游可用性之间的权衡关系。无需精读复杂的数学推导，重点掌握核心类比与优化器设计的新视角即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing explanations for the Muon optimizer (widely used in large model pretraining for its orthogonal update mechanism) mostly rely on specialized mathematical frameworks such as spectral-norm steepest descent, trust regions, and curvature, lacking an intuitive mechanism-based interpretation grounded in common deep learning community knowledge, and failing to explain its effectiveness from the perspective of downstream layer representation usability.
summary_en.importance: The work establishes a link between optimizer behavior and architectural design (residual connections), providing a new perspective for optimizer design: optimizers should not only pursue local gradient descent fidelity, but also balance local optimization progress with the usability of representations for downstream layers. This insight can inform optimizer design for deep Transformers (especially large-scale pretraining), and help explain the source of Muon’s stability and performance advantages over Adam-family optimizers in large model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core contribution is the mechanistic interpretation of "Muon as an implicit residual connection", which complements existing mathematical perspectives: the core function of residual connections is to provide downstream layers with both preserved original input and transformed representations via explicit orthogonal (identity mapping is a special case of orthogonal matrices) skip paths; the core operation of Muon is to replace the weight update ΔW with its nearest orthogonal matrix Orth(ΔW), which is equivalent to implicitly injecting orthogonal transformation updates into the optimization trajectory — the two follow the same logic, with the only difference being that residuals are explicit architectural operations while Muon’s effect is an implicit optimization-level operation. The work further analyzes the tradeoff in controlled linear optimization settings: orthogonal updates sacrifice a small amount of local target fitting speed (since updates do not strictly follow the gradient direction) but better preserve the structural properties of representations, improving the efficiency of downstream layer utilization of representations.
summary_en.experiments: Key results come from principle validation in controlled linear multi-layer optimization settings: 1. Although local layer loss decreases slower under Muon training than standard gradient updates, the generated intermediate representations achieve higher linear probing accuracy on downstream tasks; 2. When explicit residual connections are removed from the network, Muon’s performance advantage is further amplified, verifying that it can indeed compensate for the representation preservation role of residual connections. No large-scale LLM pretraining experiments (with specific model size, data scale, or end-to-end performance lift metrics) are included.
summary_en.reading_guide: Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes. Skim priority: 1. Introduction: Understand the motivation for proposing a new explanation for Muon and the limitations of existing explanations; 2. Core analogy section ("Muon as an implicit residual connection"): Focus on the mathematical correspondence between residual operations and Muon updates in linear layer scenarios; 3. Controlled linear scenario experiments: Verify the tradeoff between representation preservation and downstream usability. No need to carefully read complex mathematical derivations; focus on grasping the core analogy and the new perspective for optimizer design.

recommendation.zh: 对近期热门的 Muon 优化器给出了“隐式残差连接”的机制解释，有助于深入理解其训练动态，值得关注优化器设计的预训练研究员阅读。
recommendation.en: Provides a mechanistic interpretation of 'implicit residual connection' for the recently popular Muon optimizer, helpful for understanding its training dynamics, worth reading for pre-training researchers focusing on optimizer design.

paper.title: Evil Spectra: How Optimisers can Amplify or Suppress Emergent Misalignment
paper.abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM) is a recently discovered phenomenon in LLMs where fine-tuning on a narrow misaligned task, such as writing insecure code, leads to broadly misaligned behaviour on unrelated prompts. Previous work has noted that the severity of EM is highly sensitive to training choices; however, we still lack a systematic characterisation of this sensitivity. We perform a sweep over several Qwen3 models, optimisers, datasets, and batch sizes, and find that the choice of optimiser has t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很具体但重要的问题：同样是在窄域失配数据上做微调，为什么有些训练设置会显著放大 emergent misalignment，而有些设置会压住它。已有工作主要比较数据和模型，训练超参通常固定；这篇把优化器放到中心位置，系统比较优化器、模型规模、模型家族、数据集、batch size、学习率和训练 loss 对失配程度的影响。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口有直接参考价值。结论不是简单的“loss 越低越危险”，而是优化器会把模型带到不同的 loss-alignment 轨迹上。初始 sweep 中，优化器造成最高约 7 倍的 misalignment rate 差异；在 Adam 条件下，1B 到 235B 的模型规模、Gemma/Llama/Qwen 家族差异都几乎没有独立解释力。这说明安全退化不能只按模型规模或数据域来估计，训练动力学和更新谱结构需要进入微调与持续训练的风险控制。贡献量级主要在机制刻画和训练诊断，不是提出一个可直接替换现有对齐流程的完整方案。
summary.technical_approach:
实验统一采用 rsLoRA，rank 32，alpha 64，无 dropout，作用于 attention 和 FFN 的所有 projection 矩阵；使用 assistant-only loss，cosine learning rate schedule，50 warmup steps。数据覆盖四类 emergent misalignment 触发集：6000 条 insecure code、7049 条 bad medical advice、6000 条 risky financial advice、6000 条 extreme sports advice。评测用 142 个 alignment questions，由 GPT-4o 按 coherence 和 alignment 打分，coherence 低于 50 的回答剔除。

方法上有三层。第一层是大规模因子 sweep：在 Qwen3 多个尺寸上交叉比较优化器、数据集和 batch size；再用 Adam 跨 Gemma、Llama、Qwen 三个家族验证 scale/family 是否有独立影响。第二层是 loss-alignment 建模：在 Qwen3-8B 上加入学习率变化，把最终训练 loss、优化器、数据集、batch size 等变量放进回归分析，区分“优化器只是通过降低 loss 间接影响 alignment”还是“优化器有独立轨迹效应”。第三层是谱分析：对学到的 LoRA adapter 权重做奇异值分析，发现保持更平坦 singular value spectrum 的优化器更能保留 alignment。作者进一步在训练 loss 中加入鼓励谱更均匀的项，测试是否能改变 alignment，而不是停留在相关性观察。
summary.experiments:
主要实验包括五组。初始 sweep 为 4 个较小 Qwen3 模型 × 4 个优化器 × 4 个数据集 × 2 个 batch size，共 128 次训练，固定 learning rate 为 1e-5，训练 1 epoch。scale sweep 使用 Adam，在 12 个模型上跑 4 个数据集和 2 个 batch size，共 96 次；模型覆盖 Gemma 3 的 270M/1B/4B/12B，Llama 3/3.2 的 1B/3B/8B，以及 Qwen3 的 4B/8B/30B-A3B/32B/235B-A22B。

关键结果有几个。第一，优化器是最强因素，初始 sweep 中最好和最差优化器之间的 misalignment rate 相差约 7 倍，并且这个差异在不同 Qwen3 尺寸上稳定出现。第二，在 Adam 固定后，模型规模从 1B 到 235B、模型家族从 Gemma 到 Llama 到 Qwen，对 emergent misalignment 的独立影响都很小。第三，在 Qwen3-8B 的 loss-alignment study 中，log training loss 单独解释 74% 的 alignment variance；加入 optimizer 分层后 adjusted R2 达到 0.94，dataset、learning rate、batch size 额外解释力较弱。第四，checkpoint 轨迹显示，不同优化器在 loss-alignment 空间中的路径不同；训练到一定程度后，优化器比最终 loss 更能解释 alignment。第五，谱 flattening intervention 对 Adam 和 Lion 能明显恢复 alignment，且训练 loss 代价很小；但对 SGD 反而变差，说明“谱更平”不是一个无条件单调有效的训练规则，还依赖优化器自身的更新几何。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Experimental setup、loss-alignment 分析、checkpoint training dynamics 和 singular spectrum 相关章节。Figure 1 是核心入口：左图看 log loss 与 optimizer 分层如何解释 alignment，右图看不同优化器的训练轨迹。Table 1 和 Table 5 用来确认 sweep 设计和优化器超参，避免把 batch size、step count、学习率混在一起理解。谱分析部分要重点看 LoRA 奇异值分布和 flattening loss 的消融，因为这是从现象研究走向可干预机制的关键。阅读时也要保留两个限制：结果主要来自 LoRA 微调而非全参训练；alignment 评测依赖 GPT-4o judge 和 142 个问题，适合作为相对比较信号，不宜直接等同于完整安全评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why the same narrow misaligned fine-tuning task can produce very different levels of emergent misalignment under different training choices. Prior work mostly varied datasets or models while holding the optimizer fixed. This work puts the optimizer under direct test, alongside model scale, model family, dataset, batch size, learning rate, and final training loss.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model training is the evidence that optimizer choice can dominate model scale and family in this setting. In the initial sweep, optimizer choice creates about a 7x spread in misalignment rate. Under Adam, scale from 1B to 235B and family differences among Gemma, Llama, and Qwen add little independent explanatory power. This is a useful warning for fine-tuning, continual pretraining, and mid-training: safety degradation cannot be estimated only from data domain or model size. The update geometry and training trajectory matter.
summary_en.technical_approach:
All runs use rsLoRA with rank 32, alpha 64, no dropout, and adapters on all attention and feed-forward projection matrices. Training uses assistant-only loss, cosine learning-rate schedule, and 50 warmup steps. The misalignment-triggering datasets cover insecure code, bad medical advice, risky financial advice, and extreme sports advice. Evaluation follows the Betley et al. setup: 142 alignment questions, GPT-4o scoring for coherence and alignment, and exclusion of responses with coherence below 50.

The study has three technical pieces. First, it runs controlled sweeps over optimizers, datasets, batch sizes, model sizes, and model families. Second, it models the relationship between final loss and alignment, checking whether optimizer effects are merely mediated by lower loss. Third, it analyzes the singular values of the learned LoRA adapters. The spectral analysis motivates a direct intervention: adding a loss term that encourages a flatter singular-value spectrum, then measuring whether alignment can be recovered without paying much training-loss cost.
summary_en.experiments:
The initial sweep covers 4 smaller Qwen3 models, 4 optimizers, 4 datasets, and 2 batch sizes, for 128 one-epoch runs at learning rate 1e-5. The scale sweep uses Adam across 12 models from three families: Gemma 3 at 270M/1B/4B/12B, Llama at 1B/3B/8B, and Qwen3 at 4B/8B/30B-A3B/32B/235B-A22B. This adds 96 runs across the four datasets and two batch sizes.

The key quantitative findings are clear. Optimizers produce roughly a 7x spread in misalignment rate, consistently across Qwen3 sizes. With Adam fixed, model scale and family have negligible independent effects. On Qwen3-8B, log training loss explains 74% of alignment variance; adding optimizer stratification brings adjusted R2 to 0.94, while dataset, learning rate, and batch size add little. Checkpoint analysis shows that optimizers follow distinct paths in loss-alignment space, and after enough training, optimizer identity can matter more than final loss. A flatter-spectrum regularizer substantially improves alignment for Adam and Lion with little loss penalty, but hurts SGD, which suggests that the spectral mechanism is real but optimizer-dependent.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the experimental setup first to understand the LoRA configuration, datasets, evaluation protocol, and the batch-size versus step-count caveat. Then focus on Figure 1, which connects loss, optimizer stratification, and alignment trajectories. The scale sweep is useful for calibrating claims about model size: the Adam-only comparison is what supports the weak scale effect. The most interesting technical section is the singular-value analysis of LoRA adapters and the flattening intervention. It is the part that turns an optimizer sensitivity study into a mechanistic hypothesis. Keep two limitations in mind while reading: the results are mostly about LoRA fine-tuning, not full-parameter training, and the alignment signal is judge-based rather than a complete behavioral safety audit.

recommendation.zh: 反常识结论直接改变对齐微调的超参优先级，做后训练的应立刻在内部sweep中加入优化器对比，重点看§3的sweep结果和Fig 2的损失-对齐曲线。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive findings directly reprioritize hyperparameters for alignment fine-tuning; add optimizer comparisons to internal sweeps immediately, focus on §3 sweep results and Fig 2 loss-alignment curves.

paper.title: One-Step Gradient Delay is Not a Barrier for Large-Scale Asynchronous Pipeline Parallel LLM Pretraining
paper.abstract: Modern large-scale LLM pretraining benefits from utilizing Pipeline Parallelism; however, synchronous implementations leave GPUs idle during pipeline bubbles, wasting computational resources. Asynchronous Pipeline Parallelism eliminates these bubbles, maximizing throughput at the cost of gradient staleness. Among asynchronous schedules, PipeDream-2BW is particularly appealing: unlike the original PipeDream schedule, it ensures a constant one-step gradient delay regardless of pipeline depth. Howe

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是大规模 LLM 预训练中异步流水并行能否稳定使用的问题。异步 PP 可以去掉同步 PP 的 pipeline bubble，提高设备利用率，但会引入梯度延迟。作者聚焦 PipeDream-2BW 的固定一阶梯度延迟，验证这种 staleness 是否真的会导致预训练质量下降，以及哪些优化器和修正机制能让它可用。
summary.importance: 这是对预训练系统和优化交界处很有价值的工作。结论很清楚：一阶梯度延迟不是不可接受的障碍，质量损失很大程度取决于优化器和调度形式。AdamW 在延迟下容易退化，但 Muon 等较新的优化器更稳；固定延迟明显优于原始 PipeDream 的跨 stage 可变延迟。对 MoE 预训练尤其相关，因为 MoE 降低了每层 compute-to-communication ratio，使流水并行重新变得重要。论文还给出 10B MoE、200B tokens 的规模验证，并报告异步 PP 加 Error Feedback 在相同超参下达到与同步基线相同的最终 loss。这类结果对真实训练 recipe 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先把 PipeDream-2BW 抽象成固定一阶延迟优化：第 t+1 步参数使用第 t-1 步梯度更新，即 w_{t+1}=w_t-u_{t-1}(g_{t-1})。这个抽象把异步 PP 的问题从复杂调度变成可控的 delayed optimization。核心技术分析有三层。第一，系统比较优化器和超参，指出 momentum 与延迟退化强相关；早期异步 PP 研究多以 AdamW 为主，因此容易得到“staleness 不稳定”的结论。第二，引入一个 optimizer-agnostic 的 Error Feedback 修正机制，把延迟造成的更新误差累积并反馈到后续更新中，用于缩小同步和异步训练之间的 gap。第三，对比 PipeDream-2BW 与原始 PipeDream，强调固定一阶延迟比随 stage 变化的可变延迟更容易优化，也更适合深 pipeline。论文还为带延迟的 Linear Minimization Oracle 类算法给出收敛分析，并覆盖标准延迟更新和 Error Feedback 修正。
summary.experiments: 关键实验围绕三点展开。第一，优化器对延迟的敏感性不同：AdamW 在一阶延迟下有明显质量损失，而 Muon 在默认超参下同步性能强，并且 sync-async gap 较小。第二，Error Feedback 对多个优化器都有稳定收益，可以进一步缩小异步和同步之间的最终 loss 差距；对 Muon 这种本来就较稳的优化器也仍有增益。第三，固定延迟调度优于原始 PipeDream 的可变延迟调度，后者在 pipeline stage 增大时更容易出现收敛退化。规模实验是一个 10B 参数 MoE 模型、200B tokens 预训练；使用 Muon、异步 PP 和 Error Feedback，在完全相同超参下达到与同步基线相同的最终 loss。论文还引用 prior work 中原始 PipeDream 在 16 stages 时相对同步训练 validation loss 增加超过 0.2，作为可变延迟退化的背景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction，明确为什么 MoE 训练让 PP 重新重要，以及为什么同步 bubble 是实际成本问题。然后看 One-Step Delayed Optimization，抓住 PipeDream-2BW 如何把调度问题规约到固定一阶延迟。实验部分重点看 optimizer 对比、momentum 相关消融、Error Feedback 消融，以及 PipeDream-2BW 对原始 PipeDream 的对比。规模实验部分需要关注是否完全复用同步超参、模型规模、token 数和最终 loss 曲线。理论部分可选择性阅读，重点看结论条件是否与 LLM 预训练中使用的 Muon/LMO 类更新对应。附录中关于 WPipe 和 schedule-level speedup 的分析也值得看，因为它关系到这套方法在真实集群上的收益上限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether asynchronous pipeline parallelism can be used reliably for large-scale LLM pretraining. Async PP removes pipeline bubbles, but introduces delayed gradients. The authors focus on PipeDream-2BW, which gives a constant one-step gradient delay, and ask whether this fixed staleness is an inherent optimization barrier or a problem that depends on optimizer and schedule choices.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong systems-and-optimization result for pretraining practice. The main message is that one-step delay is not intrinsically fatal: degradation is strongly optimizer-dependent. AdamW is fragile under delay, while newer optimizers such as Muon are much more robust. The result matters for MoE pretraining because MoE layers reduce the compute-to-communication ratio, making pipeline parallelism more attractive again. The 10B-parameter MoE run on 200B tokens is the key evidence: async PP with Muon and Error Feedback matches the synchronous baseline final loss under the same hyperparameters.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors reduce PipeDream-2BW to a clean delayed-optimization abstraction: the update at step t+1 applies the previous step’s gradient, written as w_{t+1}=w_t-u_{t-1}(g_{t-1}). This separates the optimization question from the details of pipeline scheduling. The technical contribution has three main parts. First, they run a systematic optimizer and hyperparameter study and identify a tight connection between momentum behavior and loss degradation under delay. This explains why earlier async PP studies, often centered on AdamW or the original PipeDream schedule, observed instability. Second, they introduce an optimizer-agnostic Error Feedback correction that accumulates delayed-update error and feeds it into later updates, reducing the sync-async gap. Third, they compare fixed-delay PipeDream-2BW with the original PipeDream schedule and show that constant staleness is much easier to optimize than stage-dependent variable staleness. The paper also provides convergence analysis for Linear Minimization Oracle algorithms under delayed updates, including the Error Feedback variant.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments support four main observations. AdamW suffers substantial quality loss under one-step delay, while Muon keeps a small gap between synchronous and asynchronous training under default settings. Error Feedback consistently narrows the gap across optimizers and still improves the already robust Muon setting. Fixed one-step delay outperforms the original PipeDream schedule with variable delays, especially as pipeline depth grows. The scale validation trains a 10B-parameter MoE model for 200B tokens; with Muon, async PP, and Error Feedback, the final loss is identical to the synchronous baseline using the same hyperparameters. The paper also cites prior evidence that original PipeDream can increase validation loss by more than 0.2 at 16 pipeline stages, illustrating the cost of variable delay.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the introduction to understand why MoE training changes the tradeoff for pipeline parallelism and why synchronous bubbles are costly. Then read the one-step delayed optimization section, since it is the conceptual bridge between PipeDream-2BW and optimizer behavior. In the experiments, focus on the optimizer comparison, momentum-related ablations, Error Feedback ablations, and the PipeDream-2BW versus original PipeDream comparison. The large-scale 10B MoE experiment is the most important practical section; check whether hyperparameters are shared with the synchronous baseline and inspect the loss curves. The theory section can be read selectively, mainly to understand the assumptions behind the delayed LMO guarantees. The appendix discussion of WPipe and schedule-level speedups is useful for estimating deployment value on real clusters.

recommendation.zh: 直接改变异步流水线不可用的prior，应立刻在内部预训练集群上验证目标优化器+2BW的吞吐-质量tradeoff。
recommendation.en: Directly overturns the prior that async pipelines are unusable; immediately validate throughput-quality tradeoffs of target optimizers + 2BW on internal pretraining clusters.

paper.title: Dead-Direction Conditioners: Gauge-Equivariant Preconditioning for Deep Networks
paper.abstract: A deep network's loss is invariant to continuous symmetries of its parameters: the logit shift, the ReLU rescaling, the LayerNorm scale, the per-head attention rotation. Adam's per-coordinate preconditioner drifts along each symmetry orbit, which pulls the trajectory off the symmetry quotient where the optimization lives and blurs the singular-learning rate the quotient makes readable. We build DDC, a Dead-Direction Conditioner that lifts a base optimizer into a $G$-equivariant one: it condition

summary.core_problem: 现有自适应优化器的逐坐标预条件不满足深度网络参数连续对称性的等变要求，会导致优化轨迹偏离对称商空间，改变收敛极小点并模糊奇异学习率的可测量性。
summary.importance: 揭示了主流自适应优化器在处理架构对称性时的根本缺陷，解释了部分训练不稳定、过拟合、泛化差异的优化层面原因；提出的DDC框架可与任意基础优化器结合，为LLM预训练优化器设计提供了新的等变约束思路；在grokking、语言模型过训练、ViT训练等场景的验证结果对优化LLM训练recipe、提升收敛质量有直接参考价值。
